The image editor your AI agent can actually use.

The image editor your AI agent can actually use.

Release 0.20.0 · MCP · CLI · Python · REST

Vixl is an editable image-document engine built for AI agents. 30-second pitch.

Design tools are built for hands, not agents.

THE PROBLEM

01

02

03

Click-only

Flattened

Unchecked

Sliders, canvases and menus an agent cannot see or drive.

Image generators return pixels; the layers and text are gone.

Nobody knows the headline overflowed until a human looks.

Creative tools assume a person with a mouse. Agents need structure, feedback and editable output.

Design as atomic, checkable operations.

design.json

[

{

"type": "layout-apply",

"name": "hero-statement",

"title": "Launch day",

"seed": 7

},

{"type": "look", "look": "glow"}

]

THE SOLUTION

Editable .vixl masters: text, vector paths, masks, pages

179 operations, up to 10,000 per atomic batch

Structured errors with suggestions

Undo, branches, checkpoints and diffs

Every design is a document of editable layers. Every change is an operation.

One loop for every design.

Read layers, bounds and fonts

Atomic batches, up to 10,000 ops

Contrast, overlap, bounds, print

Render and look

PNG, SVG, PDF, PPTX, MP4 ...

Checks find overflowing text, low contrast, overlaps, unsafe margins, missing glyphs and print ink problems, so the agent fixes them before anyone looks.

The agent loop: inspect the document, apply a batch, run checks, preview, export.
